The shutdown signal should remain active until the temperature falls below the threshold for a certain number of clock cycles.

module temperature_shutdown(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [7:0] temperature,
    output reg shutdown
);
    parameter THRESHOLD = 8'd75; // Temperature threshold
    parameter CYCLE_COUNT = 4; // Number of cycles to wait after temperature is below threshold

    reg [1:0] count; // Counter for cycles below threshold
    reg is_over_threshold; // Flag to indicate if temperature exceeded threshold

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            shutdown <= 0;
            count <= 0;
            is_over_threshold <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (temperature > THRESHOLD) begin
                shutdown <= 1;
                is_over_threshold <= 1;
                count <= 0; // Reset count when temperature exceeds threshold
            end else if (is_over_threshold) begin
                if (count < CYCLE_COUNT - 1) begin
                    count <= count + 1; // Increment count when under threshold
                end else begin
                    shutdown <= 0; // Deactivate shutdown after counting cycles
                    is_over_threshold <= 0; // Reset flag
                end
            end
        end
    end
endmodule

    input wire rst,
    input wire send_packet,
    input wire [7:0] packet_data,
    output reg [7:0] sent_packet,
    output reg ack,
    output reg [1:0] window_status // 00: idle, 01: sending, 10: acknowledged
);

    reg [1:0] ack_ptr;  // Pointer for acknowledged packets

            send_ptr <= 0;
            ack_ptr <= 0;
            count <= 0;
            window_status <= 2'b00;

                    count <= count - 1; // decrease count
                    send_ptr <= (send_ptr + 1) % 4; // move send pointer
                    if (count == 0) begin
                        window_status <= 2'b00; // back to idle
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
